name: Glute bridge
why: Practise lifting your hips with control.

setup.space: Floor space about 2 m long to lie down.

steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor. Keep your feet about a foot length from your hips.
Rest your arms flat on the floor beside you.
Squeeze your bottom and lift your hips. Stop when shoulders, hips and knees make a straight line.
Hold for one second at the top, then lower slowly.

mistakes.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
mistakes.fix: Stop when the body is straight and keep the ribs down.
Move the feet in; shins near upright at the top.

parent_check: Straight line from shoulder to knee at the top
stop_if: Pain in the lower back, hips or knees
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Back-of-thigh cramp that does not ease with rest (end the set)

easier.use_when: The back arches or the back of the thigh cramps.

harder.variant: No later rung is authorized by this candidate.
harder.move_on_when: Unavailable until the sequence and dose rule are resolved.

dose.tempo: up in one second, hold one, down for three
